Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The road test retest fee appears twice, once in the during-the-test list [A06] and again in the failure paragraph [A07]; both state the same amount after two failures, so the dossier records it once in C and once as a confusable in C2.
The written test paragraph says the test may be taken on paper or on a computer but that language and sign language options exist at stations offering the computer test [A05]; the dossier keeps that qualifier and does not claim every station offers every language.
The federal statute citation for Social Security numbers and the Driver Evaluation Unit mailing address were summarized, not copied; the address and phone numbers are treated as dynamic [A04] [A07].
The page on identification refers learners to the DVS website for the full standard document list; the dossier states only the rules printed on the selected pages.
